name: Curse of Weakness
Effect: -30% physical attack damage, -10 Strength
Removal Method: Potion of Greater Strength or Cleansing Ritual
Description: Drains the victim's physical might, making all attacks feeble and reducing carrying capacity.

name: Curse of Slowness
Effect: -50% movement speed, -20 Agility
Description: Wraps the victim in an invisible weight, dragging their movements to a crawl.

name: Curse of Blindness
Effect: Cannot see beyond 5 feet, -40 Perception, traps harder to detect
Removal Method: Healing Magic or Eye of Truth Amulet
Description: Shrouds the victim's eyes in perpetual darkness, rendering them unable to perceive the world visually.

name: Curse of Fragility
Effect: +50% damage taken, -25 Constitution
Removal Method: Stone Skin Potion or Earth Blessing
Description: Makes the victim's body as delicate as glass, vulnerable to even the slightest impact.

name: Curse of Foolishness
Effect: -30 Intelligence, -20 Wisdom, skill checks at disadvantage
Removal Method: Tome of Wisdom or Sage's Intervention
Description: Clouds the mind with stupidity, making complex tasks impossible and reasoning flawed.

name: Curse of Clumsiness
Effect: -25 Dexterity, -15% critical hit chance, 10% chance to drop held items
Removal Method: Gloves of Grace or Dexterity Elixir
Description: Causes uncontrollable fumbling, making precise actions nearly impossible.

name: Curse of Poverty
Effect: Cannot gain gold from quests, -30% loot drops, gold pouch drains 10% per hour
Removal Method: Offering to a Merchant God or Lucky Charm
Description: Ensures that wealth slips through the victim's fingers like sand.

name: Curse of Cowardice
Effect: -40 Morale, -20% damage when HP below 50%, cannot initiate combat
Description: Fills the heart with overwhelming fear, making the victim flee from danger.

name: Curse of Rust
Effect: Equipment durability decreases 5x faster, -15% weapon damage
Removal Method: Oil of Fortification or Blacksmith's Blessing
Description: Causes metal equipment to corrode and weaken at an alarming rate.

name: Curse of Famine
Effect: Hunger drains 3x faster, food provides 50% less nutrition, cannot store food
Description: An insatiable hunger that food alone cannot satisfy.

name: Curse of Lethargy
Effect: -30% action speed, -20 Stamina regeneration, cannot sprint
Removal Method: Energy Potion or Sun God's Blessing
Description: Wraps the victim in a heavy fog of exhaustion, sapping all energy.

name: Curse of Misfortune
Effect: -25% luck, critical failures occur twice as often, random negative events
Description: Turns the tide of fate against the victim, ensuring that luck is always against them.

name: Curse of Dullness
Effect: -20 Charisma, -15% persuasion success, NPCs less friendly
Description: Strips the victim of all charm and allure, making social interactions awkward.

name: Curse of Frailty
Effect: -40% max HP, -20% healing received, slower natural regeneration
Description: Weakens the body's life force, making the victim susceptible to even minor wounds.

name: Curse of Heaviness
Effect: Encumbrance limit reduced by 50%, -15% movement speed, stamina drains faster
Description: Makes all equipment and items feel impossibly heavy.

name: Curse of Burning
Effect: Takes 5 fire damage per second, flammable items take double damage
Removal Method: Water Blessing or Fire Resistance Potion
Description: Wraps the victim in ethereal flames that cannot be extinguished by normal means.

name: Curse of Freezing
Effect: Takes 4 ice damage per second, -20% attack speed, equipment may shatter
Description: Covers the victim in a layer of magical frost that slowly saps their warmth.

name: Curse of Bleeding
Effect: Takes 3 bleed damage per second, -50% healing from potions, cannot be bandaged
Removal Method: Healing Magic or Blood Clot Potion
Description: Causes wounds that refuse to close, dripping with an unnatural crimson flow.

name: Curse of Poison
Effect: Takes 4 poison damage per second, -15% stats, chance to vomit (stun)
Description: Infuses the victim's blood with a vile toxin that slowly consumes them.

name: Curse of Shock
Effect: Takes 6 lightning damage when hit, -10% accuracy, 5% chance to stun self
Removal Method: Grounding Spell or Lightning Rod Amulet
Description: Surges with volatile electrical energy that discharges with every movement.

name: Curse of Rot
Effect: Takes 2 decay damage per second, -1 Constitution per hour, food spoils instantly
Description: Causes the victim's body and possessions to slowly decompose.

name: Curse of Acid
Effect: Takes 5 acid damage per second, equipment corrodes 10x faster
Description: Coats the victim in a corrosive substance that eats through armor and flesh alike.

name: Curse of Doom
Effect: Takes 1% max HP damage per minute, cannot heal above 50%
Description: A ticking clock of death that slowly drains the life from the victim.

name: Curse of Entropy
Effect: All stats decrease by 1 per hour, equipment randomly breaks
Removal Method: Time Reversal Spell or Essence of Stability
Description: Accelerates the natural decay of all things, unraveling the victim's existence.

name: Curse of Bloodfire
Effect: Taking damage deals 50% back to nearby allies, -20% fire resistance
Description: Infuses blood with hellish fire that erupts when the victim is wounded.

name: Curse of Silence
Effect: Cannot cast spells, cannot use verbal abilities, -30% Charisma
Removal Method: Voice Restoration Potion or Silence Breaker Scroll
Description: Steals the victim's voice, rendering all verbal magic useless.

name: Curse of Stun
Effect: 15% chance each turn to be stunned for 1 round, -10% initiative
Description: Causes intermittent paralysis that strikes without warning.

name: Curse of Fear
Effect: -30% damage vs undead/monsters, -20 Morale, may flee from combat
Description: Plants an irrational terror in the heart that grows stronger in darkness.

name: Curse of Confusion
Effect: 20% chance to attack allies, -25% accuracy, random movement
Removal Method: Mind Clarity Potion or Sage's Blessing
Description: Scrambles the victim's thoughts, making rational decision-making impossible.

name: Curse of Charm
Effect: -40% willpower, vulnerable to enemy persuasion, may betray allies
Description: Bends the victim's loyalty to the nearest hostile entity.

name: Curse of Sleep
Effect: 10% chance each turn to fall asleep for 2 rounds, -15% awareness
Description: Induces an overpowering drowsiness that cannot be resisted.

name: Curse of Curse
Effect: All other curses last 2x longer, healing reduced by 30%
Description: Amplifies the power of any other curse affecting the victim.

name: Curse of Bad Luck
Effect: -30% dodge chance, -20% critical hit, random negative events
Removal Method: Lucky Charm or Fate Reversal Ritual
Description: Ensures that every possible misfortune will find the victim.

name: Curse of Paranoia
Effect: -25% teamwork bonus, may attack allies, -15% persuasion
Description: Fills the mind with suspicion, making it impossible to trust anyone.

name: Curse of Exhaustion
Effect: -40% stamina, -20% action speed, cannot rest properly
Description: Drains all energy, making even the simplest tasks feel exhausting.

name: Curse of Death
Effect: Dies in 24 hours unless removed, -50% all stats while active
Removal Method: Wish Spell, Divine Intervention, or Ancient Artifact
Description: A death sentence placed by the gods themselves, ticking down to inevitable demise.

name: Curse of Vampirism
Effect: Takes 10 damage in sunlight, -30% Holy damage resistance, drains health on kills
Removal Method: Holy Water Ritual or Vampire Hunter's Aid
Description: Transforms the victim into a creature of the night, bound by hunger.

name: Curse of Lycanthropy
Effect: Transforms into beast during full moon, -20% control, chance to attack allies
Description: Bonds the victim to the beast within, transforming under the light of the moon.

name: Curse of the Undying
Effect: Cannot truly die, respawns with -10% max HP each time, -50% XP gain
Removal Method: True Death Ritual or Soul Release
Description: Grants immortality at the cost of eternal suffering and diminishing power.

name: Curse of the Doppelganger
Effect: Randomly transformed into another creature, -20% identity retention
Removal Method: Identity Spell or Mirror of True Self
Description: Causes the victim to lose their sense of self, shifting forms unpredictably.

name: Curse of the Void
Effect: -30% all stats in darkness, -50% Holy damage, cannot use divine magic
Description: Tethers the victim to the void between worlds, draining their connection to light.

name: Curse of the Blood Moon
Effect: All healing reversed to damage, -25% defense, enemies deal +20% damage
Removal Method: Blood Moon Ritual or Lunar Purification
Description: Under the crimson moon, all acts of mercy become acts of harm.

name: Curse of the Betrayer
Effect: -50% loyalty from allies, 10% chance to betray party, -20% reputation
Description: Marks the victim as untrustworthy, turning all allies into potential enemies.

name: Curse of the Eternal Sleep
Effect: Falls into unremovable sleep, -100% consciousness, can only be woken by removal
Removal Method: True Love's Kiss or Awakening Spell
Description: Traps the victim in a dreamless slumber from which no mortal force can wake them.

name: Curse of the Revenant
Effect: Returns from death with -20% stats, haunted by ghostly tormentors
Removal Method: Soul Binding Ritual or Ghost Banishment
Description: Doomed to walk the mortal plane as a ghostly shell, tormented by spirits.

name: Curse of Greed
Effect: Cannot drop items, -30% trade success, compulsive looting
Description: Fills the mind with an insatiable desire for material possessions.

name: Curse of Vanity
Effect: -20% armor when appearance is damaged, -15% intimidation
Removal Method: Humility Potion or Inner Beauty Spell
Description: Makes the victim obsess over their appearance, weakening them when it's marred.

name: Curse of Gluttony
Effect: -20% dodge, -15% speed, food consumption doubles, weight gain
Description: Drives an uncontrollable appetite that slows and weakens the body.

name: Curse of Wrath
Effect: -30% accuracy when enraged, may attack indiscriminately, -20% defense
Description: Fills the victim with uncontrollable rage that clouds judgment.

name: Curse of Envy
Effect: -20% damage when enemy has better equipment, -15% morale
Description: Causes the victim to resent all who have more, weakening their resolve.

name: Curse of Pride
Effect: Cannot accept help, -25% teamwork, may refuse healing
Description: Inflates the ego to dangerous levels, making cooperation impossible.

name: Curse of Sloth
Effect: -40% action speed, -30% XP gain, may skip turns
Description: Induces a crushing lethargy that makes effort feel impossible.

name: Curse of the Hive
Effect: 10% chance per turn to summon hostile insects, -15% poison resistance
Removal Method: Insect Repellent Spell or Hive Destruction
Description: Infests the victim with swarming insects that emerge from within.

name: Curse of the Mirror
Effect: Reflection attacks victim, cannot use reflective surfaces, -10% accuracy
Removal Method: Mirror Shattering Ritual or Reflection Banishment
Description: Turns the victim's reflection into a hostile entity that mirrors their actions.

name: Curse of the Void Touch
Effect: Touch deals 5 void damage, -20% Holy resistance, cannot use holy items
Description: Corrupts the victim's touch, making it harmful to allies and sacred objects.

name: Curse of the Shadow
Effect: Shadow deals 3 damage per second, -20% light magic, shadow may act independently
Description: Grants sentience to the victim's shadow, which becomes hostile.

name: Curse of the Anchor
Effect: Cannot leave current location, -30% travel speed, teleportation fails
Description: Binds the victim to a specific location, making departure impossible.

name: Curse of the Chameleon
Effect: Appearance changes randomly, -20% reputation, NPCs may not recognize victim
Removal Method: Identity Restoration or Mirror of Truth
Description: Causes the victim's appearance to shift unpredictably, eroding their identity.

name: Curse of the Leech
Effect: -5 HP per minute to nearby allies, cannot be healed by others
Removal Method: Life Transfer Ritual or Leech Removal
Description: Turns the victim into a living drain, siphoning life from those nearby.

name: Curse of the Phantom
Effect: 50% chance attacks pass through victim, cannot interact with objects
Description: Makes the victim partially incorporeal, unable to affect the physical world.
